title: REST (The Ninth Discipline)
style: ambient electronic, deeply restful male voice NZ/AU accent, warm pad chords, no percussion on verses, the music itself is resting, soft resolution, breath audible, no pitch correction, silence as punctuation, [PERSONA_NAME] voice, V4_5ALL, 60 BPM
lyrics:
``
[VERSE 1]
Sabbath — one day — the world still turns
Siesta — the south knows what the north unlearns
Ma — the Japanese space between
The pause before the haka — the most powerful scene

The hard stop — fixed scope — logs don't lie
Rest is not surrender — it's the reason why
The system breathes — the human breathes
Rest is the discipline that believes

[CHORUS]
Rest is the discipline
The pause is not weakness
Rest is the signal
That you trust the process
Stop before you're empty
Sleep before you break
Rest is the transformation
You build while you're awake

[OUTRO]
Stop.
The work will be there.
Rest is not the end.
It's how you begin again.
